tasks.prepare: deno task install && deno task fonts && deno task themes
tasks.dev: deno task content:fetch && deno task prepare && hugo server
tasks.build: deno task content:fetch && deno task content:check && deno task prepare && hugo build --minify --cleanDestinationDir
tasks.build:fixtures: deno task prepare && hugo build --minify --cleanDestinationDir --config hugo.toml,tests/fixtures/hugo.toml
tasks.test:e2e: deno task build:fixtures && deno test --allow-read --allow-write --allow-net --allow-env --allow-run tests/e2e
tasks.ci: deno task lint && deno task typecheck && deno task test && deno task test:e2e
